::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/list_views/{id}/duplicate"}
#docs
This is what makes owner-only editing workable: "this segment, but with INR too" becomes a view of your own rather than a redefinition of everybody's.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The list view's id. |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | no | Defaults to "&lt;name&gt; (copy)" |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list_view`. One of `list_view`. |
| `id` | `string` | lv_… |
| `entity` | `string` | Which list the view belongs to (subscriptions, invoices, …). |
| `name` | `string` | The list view's name. |
| `owner` | `string` | Who saved it. null for a view that belongs to the business itself. |
| `is_mine` | `boolean` | Whether the CALLER owns it — only the owner may rename, re-share, default or delete. Computed per request, never stored. |
| `visibility` | `string` | Who can see this list view. One of `private`, `business`. |
| `filters` | `array of object` | The saved filter set, in the list's own filter vocabulary. |
| `search` | `string` | The free-text search saved with the view. |
| `sort_field` | `string` | The field the view sorts by. |
| `sort_desc` | `boolean` | True if the view sorts in descending order. |
| `hidden_columns` | `array of string` | Column ids the view hides. null means the list's own defaults. |
| `is_default` | `boolean` | The view its owner lands on for this list. At most one per owner. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the list view was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the list view was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `404` | No such view, or not visible to you |
| `409` | You already have a view by that name on this list |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/list_views/lv_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/duplicate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Active subscriptions"
  }'
```
